notes.title: New Update 2.6.6.0 released
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Holidays![/h1]

New update released with a new major feature: Easy to use path system for creating walkways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/61e1d924f4a0ab1f2ed2e35bdd87915584e55962.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Path System[/h2]

It works similar to a paint program. Simply draw straigths and perfect curves. Create more complex paths by simply painting multiple straights or curve elements on top of each other. Paths will automatically be placed on top of terrain and will then stay there fixed.
Select from 10 different surface materials. Select from 4 different curb styles that will be added automatically to path edges.

This update contains many more small improvements and features, here is brief list of what else is new...

[h2]Materials[/h2]
[list]
[*]Track and supports are rendered now using true PBR materials.
[*]Both steel roller coasters and wooden roller coaster materials were changed.
[*]Specular highlights should be more realistic, especially on steel supports and track.
[/list]

[h2]Dynamic Environment[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Rayleigh scattering effect.
[*]Makes distant objects to appear slightly more blueish and brighter. Most noticeable on the far horizon.
[/list]

[h2]Editor[/h2]
[list]
[*] Coaster Properties can now be opened and changed even for frozen coasters.
[*] Added 'Choose From Selection' button. Can be used to quickly choose a scene object from a currently selected instance.
[*] Added Support Free Node Panel. Can be used to precisly set the free node's position.
[*] Added keyboard short cuts for switching views (similiar to how it works in Blender)
[*] Added 'Flatten Terrain' option. Can be used to make a region of terrain to an average height easily.        Each terrain layer now has individual texture scaling (Repeats) values. Now it should be much easier to create individual layers, because tweaking the scaling will never affect other layers.
[/list]
[h2]4D Coaster Style[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added 4D Range Offset angle option to Coaster Properties panel. This can be used to shift the range of available 4D rotation angles.
[*]Added 4D Angle on transfers option to Coaster Properties panel. This can be used to change the angle on tracks where it is not possible to add 4D parameter points.
[*]Added rail support connector '4D Special Horizontal' which is found on typical 4D coasters.
[/list]

[h2]Shadows[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved smoothened shadows with less jaggy artefacts.
[*]Fixed a problem with shadows looking weird or dissappearing on some VR headsets.
[/list]

[h2]Steam Deck and Game Controllers[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved Steam Deck support
[*]Using Steam Input now instead of XInput (Steam version only).
[*]Default Steam Deck controller layout for Steam Input added.
[*]Entering text in text boxes (such as the search field on the help window) will now open the Steam Deck virtual touch display keyboard.
[*]Improved Steam Deck detection which will make NL2 start in fullscreen mode, when started for the first time.
[*]Added a few Steam Deck and Linux related optimizations which should increase FPS slighly.
[*]The real buttons of the used controller type should now be displayed on the Controller Mapping panel, instead of showing a general XBox controller layout.
[/list]

[h2]More...[/h2]
For a more detailed list of what else is new, see in-game 'Main Menu -> Info -> What's new'...

notes.title: Update 2.6.5.4 released
notes.content:
Maintenance Update 2.6.5.4 with many improvements released...

This update addresses many track hardware (brakes and transport devices) related issues. The device placement code was completely overhauled to make it less likely that brakes and transports intersect with cross ties or segment borders. All coaster styles were examined and placement rules were fine tuned for each. Some track styles with specific support rail connectors will now not intersect with cross ties any more.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/cf0306f221fedfca423c440098a04ce1f81a47e4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/57ea9e7d61d9a7054822db76c7ef5317f7bd631d.jpg[/img][/url]

Furthermore, most older friction tire objects got updated by higher quality models or received higher detail. Some track styles also received better magnetic brake models.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/d186f96af1014f3bc0306a3f2a9e811833ed5ab6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/a5652b2425fceaaa1c39d24b91b48c4a16dbe503.jpg[/img][/url]

The editor got improved with a couple of usefull new features and fixes. First of all, there is now an 'Add on Plane' option for scenery objects, which will automatically rotate and place new objects based on the detected plane under the mouse cursor. It is very usefull for adding objects attached to walls or stacking objects on the floor. The snap settings now have moved from the preferences to the main window, for faster access.

Lift sections have received new options. Lifts now do not have to be a block. They can also now be a simple anti-rollback section without any drive devices.

There were many other smaller new additions, like a couple of new foliage objects with an experimental new LOD system.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/0e18d4f72ac15e1cf1f71157f6526d8820f43319.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/814a1fef22769a51694d5eff84a788ce35d7210a.jpg[/img][/url]

Trees were created using 'Tree It'.

For a more detailed list of what else was included in this update, see the in-game changelog (main menu -> Info -> What's new).

notes.title: New DLC available: The Vekoma MK1101 Coaster Style
notes.content:
A new add-on is available which extends the base game with an additional coaster style: The Vekoma MK1101. It is a modern and popular coaster style with a sleek design.

Vekoma Rides Manufacturing B.V. granted us an official license to use the product and company names and design for this add-on.

This add-on consists of a new train and track, recreating the real MK1101 coaster type produced by Vekoma Rides Manufacturing B.V.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/3e29a78501fa0e58fd8b543f698e93a65215e132.jpg[/img]

Features of the add-on:
[list]
[*] High detailed train with launch/chain lift option. The train's bottom side magnets will be automatically adjusted.
[*] High detailed track hardware (friction tire, LSM module, static magnetic brake).
[*] Normal and thick spine option.
[*] Two new parks demonstrating both the LSM launch and the chain lift version. 
[*] Special horizontal rotating track switch
[*] Automatically generated track covers protecting the friction tires from the chain dog in the chain lift version
[/list]

Next to selecting between launch and chain lift version, the train offers other new options:
[list]
[*]Optional handrails on front of car
[*]Optional vests on restraints
[*]Customizable nylon wheel colors
[*]Zero car cover can be removed (for scripted custom theming)
[*]Other car covers can be removed (for scripted custom theming)
[/list]

The add-on is available on Steam only. If you are a customer of the stand-alone version of NL2 purchased from our website, you are encouraged to switch to the Steam version. For a free Steam key, send an email to us (email address can be found ingame when clicking on Info) using the same email address you used to purchase the game from our website. Provide your stand-alone User ID and Key in case you do not have access to your old email address anymore.

notes.title: New Update 2.6.4.0 available
notes.content:
The new 2.6.4.0 update contains some cool new features. Fully automatic generated 3D control panels finally found their way into NoLimits 2. They are completely interactive, and can be controlled using mouse and even VR motion controllers. You can press the buttons with your index finger in VR, it is a lot of fun. Flashing lights, sounds and vibration give feedback. Even without VR, they are lot of fun using the mouse. There are two modes, either use the centered dot and left click on the buttons, or right click to show the mouse cursor and directly point on the desired button. This cursor system is also scriptable and allows for easy interaction with custom scenery, too. The control panels will be automatically generated when the standard station building is used. For custom stations, it is possible to generate the control panel at a custom location (simply add an empty control panel desk object to the location where you want the control panel to be generated). Button and lights objects are included for further customization and new scripting APIs make it also possible to implement a custom control panel more easily.

Here are the main new features listed...

[list]
[*]Automatic generated 3D Control Panels with user interaction (mouse and VR controllers)
[*]Scriptable Cursor System (for mouse and VR controller interaction)
[*]User Texture option for scene Objects
[*]Billboard Scene Object Set demonstrating the new User Texture option.
[*]Local Transform option in Editor
[*]Many more fixes and improvements... 
[/list]

See in-game change log (Main menu -> info -> What's new) for more details.

Have fun!

notes.title: New Update 2.6 Released
notes.content:
The long-awaited hybrid coaster update has finally arrived. We released the new 2.6 update on January 10th, the day of the 6th anniversary of NoLimits 2. It is free for all customers of NoLimits 2 Roller Coaster Simulation.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/f09772d87d754e9ae523b8a46e531aff943495b5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/328a997eec69ab6e38ca7632cc2fcd7caace53ee.jpg[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/e8734a9875b31f57edca97d8bd5d4bdd40787634.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/a44a44e0c05ebdc121ab3db4ae45e34952a89892.jpg[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/c41244317600325e2f241e3ce4a74776a02687ad.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6631937/14860d0af19545afd507fa41c740d039ceb91751.jpg[/img][/url]

The new hybrid coaster comes in two variations. One normal version and one LSM launch version with headrests. There is now a total of 43 different coaster styles included in the software. The new wooden support generator was completely rewritten to fit the new hybrid styles. It gives great results for inline twist inversions out-of-the-box, and only in rare cases manual adjustments are required. There are more new features and optimizations included. Here is a shortened list of the update change log:
[list]
[*] New coaster style: Hybrid Coaster (standard)
[*] New coaster style: Hybrid Coaster (launched)
[*] Two new parks demonstrating the new coaster styles
[*] Completely rewritten Wooden Support Generator
[*] Automatic supporting of inline twist inversions
[*] Automatic wide supporting for heavily banked tracks
[*] Special patterns for new hybrid coasters
[*] Normal patterns for standard wooden coasters
[*] Generates bolts and nuts
[*] Rectangular steel beams can be without paint
[*] New MSAA anti-aliasing option
[*] Improved Shadows
[*] Improved loading times of parks
[/list]

For the full change-log, inside the software, from the main menu, click on [i]Info[/i] -> [i]What's new[/i].

[The NL Dev Team]

notes.title: Update 2.5.6. released
notes.content:
We recently brought out v2.5.6 which is a minor update with some internal changes and optimizations.

Users with high resolution displays (Retina/4k) who prefer running the program in Window mode, may try out the new Window Half Resolution option, which is available when a display with a high resolution is detected. 

Setup -> Display: 

Display Mode: Window
Resolution: Half Window Resolution

This special window mode makes the program render at half resolution which can tremendiously improve framerates, especially on laptops (e.g. MacBooks with Retina displays).

Full change log of update can be seen inside the program (Info -> What's new).

notes.title: New Update 2.5 Released
notes.content:
We are proud to have released the new major update for NoLimits 2 with lots of new features.

[img]http://downloads.nolimitscoaster.com/steampictures/2500updatenews.jpg[/img]

Here is a list of the most important changes

[h1]New Deferred Shading Renderer[/h1]

This new renderer allows much higher framerates when having lots of light sources and is optimized for medium to high end graphics cards. Here are some of the key features of the new engine:

[h1]Improved Light Source Rendering[/h1]

[list]
[*]Engine scales much better with high number of light sources
[*]Scales much better with high end graphics cards by reducing driver load (less draw calls)
[*]Even light sources that are very far away will be rendered
[*]Improved computation using linear color space for more realistic visuals
[/list]

[h1]New Graphics Effects[/h1]

[list]
[*]Custom implementation of Screen-space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO) greatly improving visuals
[*]Bloom effect
[*]Sun shafts effect
[*]High Dynamic Range lighting with adaptive iris effect (works great together with bloom effect)
[*]New underwater caustics effect
[/list]

[h1]Smarter Engine[/h1]

[list]
[*]New automatic occlusion detection system (manual occluders are rarely needed anymore)
[*]Improved light shafts with higher quality and performance (allows much cooler light effects, such as lasers)
[*]SMAA anti-aliasing (Copyright (C) 2011 by Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria, Tiago Sousa, Belen Masia, Fernando Navarro and Diego Gutierrez.) for best trade-off between performance and quality
[/list]

[h1]New Park Objects[/h1]

[list]
[*]New park lamp set (over 20 new scene objects)
[*]New fence set (over 13 new fence types, each coming with multiple variations)
[*]New bench set (over 15 new scene objects)
[*]New trash can set (5 new scene objects)
[*]High Definition foliage set (10 new scene objects)
[/list]

[h1]Improved Sound Effects[/h1]

[list]
[*]Various coaster styles have received brake sound updates
[*]Moveable magnetic brakes sound added
[*]Gate sound added
[/list]

The NL Dev Team

notes.title: New Update with Flat Ride Pack released!!
notes.content:
The NoLimits 2 team is proud to announce a new update (2.1.5.0) containing all new scripted rides!

[img]http://www.nolimitscoaster.de/images/ridepack201505/steamnewshead.jpg[/img]

This update is free to all NoLimits 2 users. The update adds five professionally modeled and scripted rides to the Observation tower released in the last update. Features:

[list]
[*]Professionally modeled with multiple LODs for high performance.
[*]Drop in and play! All rides are scripted with animation and sound effects ready to go. Just add to your park like any other pre-built scenery object.
[*]All rides can be ridden! Approach the ride and press E when prompted to board the ride.
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F8CdEy-pxz0

Enjoy! Be sure to share this video and leave us a comment letting us know what you think of the new additions!

-NoLimits Dev Team

notes.title: New Update 2.1.0.0 with Wing Coaster out now!!
notes.content:
The NoLimits team wishes you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

[img]http://nolimitscoaster.de/images/nolimits2/nl2100_2.jpg[/img]

The new update 2.1.0.0 with the new Wing Coaster is now available. We are proud to present you this astonishing coaster style implemented in NoLimits 2 using highly detailed 3d models and textures. We also give you two new parks with three new coasters, so you can instantly try out the new coaster style. Kudos to Seth Parsons for contributing another great park file.
This is our Christmas present for our great community. We hope you like it as much as we do.
